Axis-aware: in a flex column `"y"` is justify-content, in a row it is align-items; a grid uses justify-items/align-items. To centre the element itself inside its parent, use `mar: "center"`.

params.name: cursor

params.description: Grid placement — {col, row}, written to grid-column and grid-row.

params.description: DOM id on the input.

params.name: keySet
params.description: Escape hatch — {key, value} written straight to element.style, or an array of them.

params.name: mar
params.description: Margin. The same array-of-side-objects form as `pad`: `mar: [{a: 40}]`, keys `a t r b l`, combinable. Additionally `mar: "center"` sets left and right to auto, as does `{a: "auto"}` or `{center: true}`.

params.name: pad
params.description: Padding. An array of side objects: `pad: [{a: 40}]`. Keys are `a` all, `t` top, `r` right, `b` bottom, `l` left. Keys combine, so `{tb: 12}` sets top and bottom. A bare number is treated as px; any string is passed through, so `{a: "2rem"}` works.
